name: reverseimg
description: ReverseIMG - reverse image search and keyword image search for Firefox.
author: matthew (https://github.com/shuriv)

scripts.start: npm run build && web-ext run --source-dir dist --watch-files dist
scripts.build:amo: npm run version:sync && cross-env AMO=1 vite build
scripts.package: npm run build:amo && web-ext build --source-dir dist --artifacts-dir artifacts --overwrite-dest
scripts.package:dev: npm run build && web-ext build --source-dir dist --artifacts-dir artifacts --overwrite-dest
scripts.sign: npm run build:amo && web-ext sign --source-dir dist --artifacts-dir artifacts --channel listed
scripts.test:all: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run i18n:check && npm run build:amo && npm run lint:ext
